stepTitle: The sum of the residuals is $$0$$
stepBody: The owner collects $$n$$ $$=$$ $$30$$ observations and fits an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model with $$29$$ features (e.g., foot traffic, temperature, etc.) with an intercept (30 parameters total). The model is: $$\hat{y}_{i}=\hat{\theta}_{0}+\hat{\theta}_{1}x_{i1}+\hat{\theta}_{2}x_{i2}$$ + ... + $$\hat{\theta}_{29}x_{i29}$$ Which of the following is always true?
